confidence_notes: Restaurant and beverage anchors rest on crowd-sourced listings (Numbeo, Almurakib) and budget guides with unverified dates, so they are ballpark figures. Cocktail and wine are not directly priced; they are set as multiples of the draft beer anchor (about 3.5x and 4x) because no Ninh Binh drink menus were found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates with no accommodation search, so they carry the most uncertainty. The FX observation is the most recent RBA table value I could verify (20 March 2026). I could not retrieve the RBA's latest F11.1 observation, and the value is about seven months old. Third-party data for late August 2026 points to roughly 0.72, but I did not use it because it is not an RBA source.
comparable_city_reasoning: Northern Vietnamese provincial tourist town. Drink prices come from Numbeo and Almurakib Ninh Binh listings. The mid-range dinner for two uses the citycost.org Ninh Binh vs Hanoi comparison, which puts Ninh Binh about 22% below Hanoi. Inexpensive meal prices come from local dish prices in Vietnamese travel budget guides. Cocktail and wine are derived from the beer anchor because direct local prices were not found. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from general knowledge of the Ninh Binh and Tam Coc lodging market, without any accommodation search.
